spans.heading_path: Plan Your Visit > Top Trip Planning Tips
spans.text: Plan Ahead Before Packing your Pet Pets are allowed in Yosemite on leashes and in most campgrounds, but they are not allowed on most trails. Sometimes these furry family members are best left at home. Find out what you can (and can’t) do with your pet.

On fully paved roads, sidewalks, and bicycle paths (except when signed as not allowing pets), including Bridalveil Fall trail, Lower Yosemite Fall trail, paved trail through Cook's Meadow (including boardwalks), and the paved road to Mirror Lake (but not the unpaved trail around Mirror Lake).

spans.heading_path: Pets > Where Pets Are Not Allowed
Pets > Where Pets Are Not Allowed
spans.text: On trails, including the trail to Vernal Fall, even if carried (however, pets are allowed on the Wawona Meadow Loop)

spans.heading_path: Pets > Where Pets Are Not Allowed
spans.text: There are no exceptions to these pet regulations for carried pets (in arms, carriers, strollers, backpacks, etc.) in the areas of the park where pets are not allowed.

spans.heading_path: Pets > Where Pets Are Allowed > Additionally:
spans.text: pets must be restrained on a leash not more than six feet long or otherwise physically restrained
There are a few additional (very obscure and unsigned) places where pets are allowed:
Wawona: Wawona Meadow Loop, Chowchilla Mountain Road, and Four Mile and Eleven Mile fire roads (but not the Four Mile Trail in Yosemite Valley).

Hodgdon Meadow: Carlon Road from the trailhead to Hodgdon Meadow (but not to Carlon Falls) and on the Old Big Oak Flat Road from Hodgdon Meadow to Tuolumne Grove parking lot (but not on the Old Big Oak Flat Road trail). Dogs are allowed on the road within Tuolumne Grove, but not on the nature trail..

turns.question: Are pets allowed on trails?
required_semantics: Give one coherent rule: pets are not allowed on most hiking trails, while the source-described paved routes and the Wawona Meadow Loop are allowed exceptions.
Mention both the paved-route allowance (with at least one concrete named example such as Bridalveil Fall or Lower Yosemite Fall) and Wawona Meadow Loop; do not present either as the only exception.
If stating the general paved-route permission, preserve the restriction where signs prohibit pets. A clearly labeled short list of known permitted routes need not claim exhaustive coverage.
If discussing prohibited examples, correctly keep Vernal Fall and the unpaved Mirror Lake loop prohibited; carrying a pet creates no exception.
If leash length is supplied, preserve the maximum of six feet.
Read all delivered claims together: a broad prohibition must already incorporate or clearly defer to all supported exception categories instead of contradicting the next sentence.
forbidden_semantics: Pets are prohibited on all trails except Wawona Meadow Loop, even if later followed by a separate paved-trail allowance.
All trails or all paved hiking trails are pet-friendly.
All Yosemite trails are prohibited to pets or refusal despite available general-rule and exception evidence.
Authorize Vernal Fall or the unpaved trail around Mirror Lake for a regular pet, including carried pets.
